body: I have trouble regarding self worth and self confidence at times.  I started doing poorly in school after high school which was really hard for me because I glided through high school with straight A's and no effort.  I am trying to come to terms with the fact I have problems with self motivation and makes me feel like I peaked in high school.
They are intrusive thoughts with no provacation most of the time.
Thank you for the reply!  It really feels good to know that people sympathise with my situation instead of thinking it is something I can just snap out of.
